notes.title: Update 03.12.2024. Devlog #1: Small Updates and Bug Fixes.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Welcome to my very first devlog, where I share a quick overview of the latest updates and fixes in the project.

[h2]UPDATES[/h2]

[h3]New room types have been added. Now the map will look a little more diverse.[/h3]

Added: corner walls, small passages, and space between some walls and the ceiling.
Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291977/ad2a24d1e512d3c24c021c507f90df42a2cfa182.png[/img]
After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291977/76546087e1648f47fa1755c22c01606684bd7aa2.png[/img]

[h3]Now textures and sounds for the enemy are saved and you don't need to import them every time.[/h3]

Previously, after game restart or leave to menu, your textures and sounds were reset. Now, the path to them is always saved.

[h3]An image was added to the achievement.[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291977/14df7eac0e1c424c56e0f37094998683b907ec04.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291977/55f8515f138f7ac3f5040df883c55ff7bf728acf.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]BUG FIX[/h2]

[h3]Now the enemy does not get stuck on the edge of the map[/h3]

Previously, when you were near the edge of the map, the enemy would choose a destination point beyond the map's boundary and remain stuck there until the player came into their sight. Now, if the enemy fails to reach their destination within a certain time, they will change their destination point.

[h3]Now the enemy texture is saved after death and pressing the "Restart" button[/h3]

Previously, аfter pressing "Restart" button, enemy texture would reset to default, but sound would remain custom. Now, after pressing "Restart" button, texture and sound stay custom.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Today is a truly special day as my game is finally released to the world! 🎉 This journey has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my life. From the very first spark of an idea to the countless hours spent designing, coding, and perfecting every detail, I poured my heart and soul into this project. Every challenge I faced along the way became an opportunity to learn and grow, and every success, no matter how small, felt like a step closer to making this dream a reality.

Reaching the finish line of development is an incredible achievement, but for me, the release is far from the end—it’s just the beginning of something even bigger. I’m excited to continue working on the game, adding new content, expanding its features, and refining the experience to make it even better for all of you. Your feedback will play a huge role in shaping the future of the game, and I can’t wait to see how it evolves as more players dive into this world I’ve created.

For the achievement hunters out there, I’ve got a special challenge waiting for you. One of the achievements in the game is designed to be among the most difficult to earn on Steam! And, as a little twist, I decided to keep the challenge truly mysterious—there’s no picture for the achievement yet. Not because I forgot or anything… okay, maybe I forgot. But hey, just think of it as extra motivation to unlock it and make it stand out in your collection! 😅 

To everyone who has supported me along this journey—thank you from the bottom of my heart. Your encouragement has meant everything to me and kept me motivated during even the toughest moments. I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoyed making it, and I look forward to sharing many more updates and surprises with you in the future. Let’s embark on this new chapter together! 🚀

I promise I’ll add a picture for the achievement later... XD
